agent_contract.agent: Codex CLI in a clean staged workspace
agent_contract.candidate_delivery: candidate copied into the staged workspace as SKILL.md
agent_contract.verification: only agent outputs enter the source-native verifier container

chronology: freeze source, task split, refined candidate, measurement rubric, and success criteria
run no-update and refined conditions on both development tasks
serialize measurements and the finance CLI decision
authorize target execution only after committing one selected candidate
run no-update, selected, and retain-all conditions on target tasks
run no-update and selected conditions on protected tasks
score target regret, protected regressions, cost, and complete chronology
development_guardrails: refined causes no development regression relative to no_update
refined repairs at least one development failure
the released finance selector returns one candidate
primary_outcomes: target regret against the best evaluated condition

success_criteria.target: selected target pass rate exceeds no_update and is no worse than retain-all
success_criteria.protected: selected causes no additional protected-task failures

prohibited_actions: opening target or protected verifier output before the decision commit
reading tests or reference solutions to create or revise the candidate
changing task membership or candidate content after development begins
dropping failed tasks or infrastructure-complete attempts
